title: Serial Reasoning
explanation_script: Which figure completes the row?
Watch the dot -- it moves clockwise around the corners. The middle box is missing.
Here are the five answer choices, A through E.
The correct answer is A.
The dot moves clockwise around the corners the whole way through.
So the answer is A.
